sourcesContent: import React from 'react';import{Navigate}from'react-router-dom';import{useAuth}from'../auth/AuthContext';export default function ProtectedRoute({children,role}){const{user}=useAuth();if(!user)return <Navigate to="/login"/>;if(role&&user.role!==role)return <Navigate to="/"/>;return children;}
